description: A coalition of EU member states, alarmed by the frontier access denial and ongoing fragmentation, initiates an emergency coordination pact with Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan to jointly secure access to advanced AI training runs and share sovereign evaluation frameworks. The pact focuses on mutual compute access and joint red-teaming of frontier models, leveraging the Union’s supply-chain leverage and the partners’ technical depth. It emerges outside formal EU structures but gains quiet support from several national governments.
